title: Getting Started — a sample walkthrough
subtitle: Copy this file and edit it to author your own
author: MarkdownViewer

steps.narration: Welcome! A walkthrough is a guided tour: each step shows narration and can drive the app (open a file, highlight code, show a diagram).
A step can open a file in the editor. Paths are resolved relative to this script's rootHint (set it to your project root).
It can also highlight a range of lines to draw the reader's eye to the relevant code.
A single step may run several actions in order — open a file and highlight within it.
